questions.question: Evaluate: 10 - 3 × 2 + 4
questions.explanation: Follow order of operations (PEMDAS): 10 - 3 × 2 + 4 = 10 - 6 + 4 = 4 + 4 = 8.
questions.fastStrategy: PEMDAS: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiply/Divide (left to right), Add/Subtract (left to right).

questions.question: Evaluate: 2³ - 3 + 5 × 2
Evaluate: (6 + 2) × 3 - 4
questions.explanation: Parentheses first: 6 + 2 = 8. Then 8 × 3 = 24. Finally 24 - 4 = 20.

questions.question: Evaluate: 20 ÷ 4 + 3 × 2 - 1
questions.explanation: Divide: 20 ÷ 4 = 5. Multiply: 3 × 2 = 6. Then 5 + 6 - 1 = 10.
questions.fastStrategy: Multiply and divide (left to right) before add and subtract.
